learning_data.name: What is Binary
learning_data.info: Binary is a numeriing scheme used by computers to represent characters on a computer. The values of binary can only be 0 and 1.

learning_data.name: Binary can be Fun
learning_data.info: Lets try to make a game out of binary. Lets say that the four elelements: fire, earth, wind, and water all have an associated binary value to them.

learning_data.name: Remember
learning_data.info: Remember!  Remember the rules to the game: 00 : earth  01 : wind
